verdict.rationale: HubSpot Marketing Hub ships AI agents such as the campaign agent, so connecting external MCP servers to it is a fair question. The evidence only documents HubSpot's own official MCP server, which is the server role and does not count toward this client-side story. Nothing shows users can plug third-party MCP servers into HubSpot so its AI can call their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
